title: SLIMbus-style TDM bus interface (framer or device) with one transmit and one receive data channel

fields.desc: 1 = framer (drives CLK, frame sync and FI)
framer: CLK half period - 1 (PCLK); 3 or more

regs.name: CHAN
regs.desc: Data channel segments (TAG slot + 2 slots per byte, inside slots 1..95 or 97..191)

regs.name: SFSET
regs.desc: Framer: writing SFSET loads the superframe count sent in the next superframe

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Transmit sample (the low CHAN.cfg_tx_len bytes); writing TX commits it for the next segment

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received sample; reading RX frees it

fields.desc: superframe found; the data channels run
a channel segment is invalid (that channel is off)
FI information byte of the last superframe
superframe count of the last superframe

irqs.name: FI
irqs.desc: a complete FI was received (STATUS.fi_info / sf_count updated)

irqs.name: LOST_SYNC
irqs.desc: frame sync lost (two misses, or no superframe within 16 frames)

irqs.name: TX_UNDERRUN
irqs.desc: a transmit segment found no sample (sent as not present)

irqs.name: RX_ERR
irqs.desc: a receive segment TAG had reserved bits set

notes: slim_clk_o / slim_clk_oe / slim_clk_i and slim_dat_o / slim_dat_oe / slim_dat_i are the bus pins (open drivers onto CLK and DATA; DATA needs a bus keeper); all pass through unchanged.
